name: Leadville
description:
About This Game

The silver rush has transformed the quiet frontier town of Leadville into a battleground for greed and justice. When a gang of bandits ambushes a silver carriage bound for the bank, a deadly showdown ensues. Will the sheriff’s posse manage to protect the valuable shipment, or will the outlaws make off with the loot?

Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying tooutmaneuver their rivals. The map is filled with obstacles and boons: covers, aids, and traps, and the ever-moving gold wagon that may decide the game’s finale.

In the Wild West, there are no second chances: only those with quick thinking and a steady aim prevail. Choose which side of the law you're on.

Leadville is a video game adaptation of the same-named tabletop game by Ramezware.

SUPPORTED PLAY MODES:

Campaign

Single Player (PvE)

PvP (up to 4 players)
